title: beilschmiedia austin-smithii
intro: Beilschmiedia austin-smithii, commonly known as New Caledonia laurel, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Beilschmiedia austin-smithii include analgesic and antipyretic effects, likely due to its bioactive constituents such as diterpenes and sesquiterpenes. However, the information about the specific bioactive constituents of Beilschmiedia austin-smithii is limited, and more research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
